definitions.award_count: every published award row for the buyer, placeholder supplier identities included
definitions.distinct_supplier_count: distinct normalised supplier names over identified awards - an UPPER bound (name variants under-merge), same gate
definitions.identified_award_count: awards whose supplier identity is real: supplier id not the '0' placeholder and the name not a placeholder artifact - the concentration denominator
definitions.median_rand/iqr_rand: median + IQR of flag-clean award amounts (zero / lt_R100 / gt_R10bn excluded), published only at N >= 30 clean amounts - medians only, never means
definitions.single_win_supplier_share_pct: newcomer-openness PROXY: share of identified awards won by suppliers appearing exactly once at this buyer in the published record, same gate - a proxy within the published-awards dataset only
definitions.top_supplier_share_pct: share of the buyer's IDENTIFIED awards won by its most-awarded supplier (conservative name normalisation, no fuzzy merging), published only at N >= 30 identified awards
